external_invariants: Model is ResNetForImageClassification loaded from the local assets directory only (local_files_only=True) in float32; no downloads.
All weights and activations remain FP32; torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 and torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 are False and torch.set_float32_matmul_precision('highest').
Seed policy: torch.manual_seed(20261020) applied in prepare, matching common.configure().

Input is the real preprocessed image fixture tensor from assets/pixels.npy (3 images, NCHW float32), selected as images[torch.arange(batch) % len(images)].contiguous(); for the frozen 'online' workload batch=1, i.e. the first image, unchanged every repeat.
The model is in eval() mode and the forward pass runs under torch.inference_mode(), identical to the source infer() helper calling model(pixel_values=pixels).logits.
Batch size is fixed at 1 for this workload; the workload, data, precision and output requirements are not altered to improve the score.
Correctness requires all logits within atol=1e-4 / rtol=1e-4 and exact top-1 argmax equality against the reference; observations include every logit and the predicted class integer.

Latency is wall time around run() with CUDA synchronization at both boundaries, per the source's per-repeat timing; throughput is derived from the unchanged work amount (batch=1) and the measured elapsed time.
The adapter does not initialize CUDA or load the model at import time and never destroys the process group in reset.

selection.rationale: Single-device task (communication not_applicable) with exactly one coherent editable boundary: all 81 CUDA kernels and 715.8 us of inclusive kernel time associate to the root call 5d7d6bb13691b02f533f62b0 (group 3c57c8731ec33ed76cbb, 'complete workload'); the only other observed groups are profiler enter/exit discovery hooks (0 us CUDA, no workload semantics) and the (1,1000) logits clone emitted inside the current replay path, which is a child of the root call and is listed in affected_calls rather than targeted independently. Previous feedback contains no failure to repair: trial-d3cc996c55 (whole-forward CUDA-graph capture of this same boundary) was accepted, moving the clean paired objective from 1.708-1.726/1.717 ms to 0.741 ms with bitwise-equal logits (max_abs_error 0.0 on 1001 elements at both continuous steps) and complete coverage of the required call, so the accepted parent is the graph-replaying run(), not the 1.63 ms original baseline (whose 3.37 ms discovery wall time is perturbed hook timing and not comparable). That accepted change eliminated CPU launch overhead: the residual gap between the 0.741 ms objective and 715.8 us of inclusive kernel time is ~25 us, so launch-side edits have no measurable headroom and only shrinking kernel time can move latency_ms. Kernel evidence on the current revision shows the remaining cost is conv math plus separable glue: 13 scudnn winograd 3x3 convs 346.9 us, 7 legacy implicit_convolve_sgemm convs (stem 7x7 and 1x1 downsample path, no fused activation) 230.2 us, 55.6 us of Winograd tile transforms, 42.8 us across 20 standalone eval-BatchNorm kernels, 20.5 us across 17 clamp/ReLU kernels, 9.3 us of residual adds, and ~10 us of gemv/maxpool/mean. The ~63 us BN/ReLU glue and the 230 us unfused conv path are removable by algebraic reparameterization of the frozen eval-mode model during untimed setup, which is again a replacement of the invocation's execution plan rather than a per-op edit; the proposal must preserve the frozen FP32/TF32-off/benchmark-off policies, the fixed fixture input, and the fresh-logits-per-run result structure of the accepted parent, falling back to the parent implementation on any guard or quality failure.
selection.hypothesis: Reparameterizing the frozen eval-mode model in untimed setup - folding every eval BatchNorm into the preceding conv's FP32 weights and biases, fusing the residual add+ReLU epilogues elementwise, and converting weights/activations to channels_last before re-capturing the existing CUDA graph - will eliminate the 20 bn_fw_inf_1C11_kernel_NCHW kernels and most clamp kernels and move the 7 implicit_convolve_sgemm convs onto cudnn's faster vectorized NHWC kernels, cutting GPU-busy time by roughly 60-120 us (0.741 ms to approximately 0.62-0.68 ms), which must exceed the ~0.055-0.059 ms MAD-derived noise bounds under the AB/BA protocol. Because BN folding and the layout change alter summation order, logits are expected to differ from the parent by up to ~1e-5 and must still satisfy atol=rtol=1e-4 with exact top-1 argmax equality (unlike the graph-only trial, bitwise equality is not expected); if any quality check, guard, or capture fails, the candidate falls back to the accepted parent implementation so correctness never depends on the reparameterization succeeding. This is a hypothesis to be tested by the independent measurement, not an accepted benefit.

proposal.rationale: Previous feedback contains no failure to repair: trial-d3cc996c55 (whole-forward CUDA graph capture of this same project.invoke boundary) was accepted with clean paired objective 0.741 ms vs the 1.708-1.726/1.717 ms parent values, bitwise-equal logits (max_abs_error 0.0 on 1001 elements at both continuous steps) and full coverage of required call 5d7d6bb13691b02f533f62b0. That changes this attempt as follows: the effective baseline is the graph-replaying run() (the installed bundle trial-d3cc996c55-param-9225be44), whose residual launch-side overhead over the 715.8 us of inclusive kernel time is only ~25 us, so only GPU kernel time can move latency_ms now. This candidate keeps the accepted replay structure (one CUDAGraph over the whole frozen forward on the frozen pixels, fresh clone of the static logits per invocation, so result structure and per-run aliasing match adapter.run and the replaced bundle) and shrinks the kernels inside the graph with the selected hypothesis: during the untimed first invocation, every eval (Conv2d -> BatchNorm2d) adjacency is folded algebraically into the conv (W' = W * gamma/sqrt(running_var+eps) per output channel, b' = (b - running_mean) * s + beta), each folded BatchNorm2d is replaced by nn.Identity, all conv weights are moved to channels_last, and the graph is recaptured over a channels_last copy of the frozen input. Observed kernel evidence motivating each piece: 20 standalone bn_fw_inf_1C11_kernel_NCHW kernels (~42.8 us) disappear entirely because their affine math now lives in the conv weights; the 7 implicit_convolve_sgemm convs (stem 7x7, shortcut 1x1s and classifier path, 230.2 us total, e.g. 22.21/29.57/35.71/116.17 us single kernels) move onto cudnn's NHWC-optimized kernels under channels_last; the 3x3 winograd convs and clamp/add/maxpool/mean kernels re-select for NHWC layouts with no algebraic change. Target is a 60-120 us GPU-busy reduction (0.741 -> ~0.62-0.68 ms), which must clear the ~0.055-0.059 ms MAD-derived noise bounds under the AB/BA protocol; this is a hypothesis for independent measurement, not a claimed benefit. Correctness safety: before capture the folded channels_last forward is compared on the real fixture against a just-computed baseline from the unmodified model using the task's own tolerances (atol=rtol=1e-4) plus exact top-1 equality; any mismatch, unrecognized module structure (no foldable adjacency), guard change (model identity, pixels data_ptr/shape/dtype, device, eval mode) or capture failure restores the original modules and permanently falls back to the parent reference callable, so quality never depends on the reparameterization succeeding. eliminated_calls is empty at the call-ID level: the inner aten invocations (including the ~20 BN calls being removed and the logits clone ff665ce97a6a868dae8ae228, which is deliberately preserved as the per-run fresh clone) live inside the project.invoke boundary and were already subsumed by the replaced execution-plan bundle's 356 affected calls; the framework recaptures the plan, and every consumer of a folded conv+Identity boundary receives an algebraically equivalent tensor at the same program point, so no external output or state changes.

setup_work.when: lazily on the first replacement invocation (warmup/quality phase, untimed relative to the repeats); nothing is precomputed from fixtures - every timed invocation replays the real kernels
steps: one inference_mode forward of the unmodified model to record baseline logits on the actual fixture

algebraic BN folding: per (conv, bn) pair one fused weight multiply and one fused bias expression on the GPU under no_grad, bn module swapped for nn.Identity, all conv weights made channels_last-contiguous
one folded channels_last forward plus isclose/argmax self-check against the baseline
3 side-stream warmup iterations of the folded forward for cudnn heuristic kernel selection (cudnn.benchmark stays false per the frozen policy)
CUDAGraph capture of the whole folded forward on a channels_last static input, one verification replay + synchronize, then release of the pre-fold weight/module undo references

memory.setup_transient: during folding both the original (~11.7M fp32 params, ~45 MiB) and fused conv-weight storages are alive, plus small per-fold temporaries; this raises framework.lifecycle_peak_allocated_bytes/lifecycle_peak_reserved_bytes but not the per-run framework.peak_allocated_bytes, which is reset before each run
memory.retained: fused channels_last conv weights and folded biases (~45 MiB, replacing the originals after the undo references are released); retained BatchNorm2d modules and their buffers are dropped after successful capture; static channels_last input (~0.6 MiB); the CUDAGraph private pool holding static activations and cudnn workspaces (same class of retained pool as the accepted replaced bundle, order of ~tens of MiB); per-run the only fresh allocation is the (1,1000) logits clone outside the graph pool
memory.counters: the declared metric is latency_ms; any allocation-counter movement is setup/retained accounting above, not claimed as a general physical-memory saving

quality_risks: BN folding and the channels_last/NHWC kernel re-selection change summation order, so logits are no longer bitwise-equal to the parent graph trial (which had max_abs_error 0.0); expected deviation is up to ~1e-5 absolute against the reference, which must satisfy atol=rtol=1e-4 - guarded by the pre-capture isclose self-check on the real fixture, with restore+parent fallback on violation
exact_top1 could flip if the fixture's top-2 logits were within the deviation; guarded by the explicit argmax-equality self-check before capture, falling back to the parent if it fails

module-structure discovery is name-agnostic (any Conv2d whose next registered sibling is an eval BatchNorm2d is folded); if the installed transformers variant does not match that adjacency, no fold happens and the candidate permanently falls back to the parent reference

guard mismatch after a successful capture (different model object, pixels pointer/shape/dtype, device, or train mode) falls back to the parent callable while the model remains folded - algebraically equivalent within tolerance, and the frozen workload never triggers this path

replacing BatchNorm2d with nn.Identity lets an in-place ReLU write into the conv output buffer inside the graph's private pool; addresses are stable across replays and the buffer has no other consumer, so per-run outputs and aliasing (fresh logits clone each invocation) are unchanged
